confirmed.what: Ses ekranındaki X (Kapat) butonu kayıt sürerken yalnızca setIsRecording(false)+setScreen('main') yapıyor; stopRecording() hiç çağrılmıyor. voice.service.ts modül-seviyesi `recording` nesnesi aktif kalıyor (voice.service.ts:11). confirmed.fix: log.tsx:813 onPress'i şu yap: () => { if (isRecording) { void stopRecording(); } setIsRecording(false); setScreen('main'); } — stopRecording modüldeki recording'i unload edip null'luyor (voice.service.ts:43-50). Ek olarak log.tsx:505'teki mesajı 'Kayıt başlatılamadı — mikrofon iznini kontrol et.' yaparak yanlış teşhisi yumuşat.

verdict.reason: Confirmed by reading the code. app/log.tsx:813 onPress is exactly `() => { setScreen('main'); setIsRecording(false); }` — no stopRecording(). voice.service.ts:11 holds the module-level `recording` object; the only path that unloads it is the isRecording=true branch of handleVoiceToggle (log.tsx:483) or stopAndTranscribe (unused by log.tsx). Grep confirms no unmount cleanup or other stopRecording call anywhere in log.tsx, so after X the expo-av Recording stays prepared and the mic stays live. On the next 'Sesle gir', startRecording (voice.service.ts:16-34) re-requests permission (granted), then Audio.Recording.createAsync throws expo-av's 'Only one Recording object can be prepared at a given time' — the bare catch swallows it and returns false, and log.tsx:504-505 maps every false to the misleading 'İzin gerekli — Mikrofon izni ver.' alert. Since the module `recording` is never nulled, every retry fails identically until app restart. Chain fully verified, severity 'high' is fair for a Premium feature that hard-locks with a wrong diagnosis while keeping the mic hot.
verdict.fix_note: Fix fits the architecture: stopRecording() (voice.service.ts:39-52) unloads and nulls the module recording, resets allowsRecordingIOS, and nulls the ref even on error, so `if (isRecording) { void stopRecording(); }` in the X onPress fully releases the lock; fire-and-forget is safe since the URI is discarded intentionally. The log.tsx:505 message softening ('Kayıt başlatılamadı — mikrofon iznini kontrol et.') is a sensible companion since startRecording conflates permission-denied with any createAsync failure. Minor optional hardening not required by the finding: a useEffect unmount cleanup calling stopRecording would also cover leaving the screen via back gesture/navigation, which the X-button fix alone does not.
